data.name: MetaDescription
data.value: Ecnanib runs AI trading agents on Binance. AI models propose each trade, and deterministic rules decide whether an order is sent.

data.value: Ecnanib is not financial advice, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance. Automated trading can lose money.
data.comment: EXT-UI-03 and CON-14, on every page. Keep the phrases "not financial advice" and "not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance". Pending legal review in #58.

data.name: LandingIntro
data.value: Ecnanib runs trading agents on Binance Spot and USDⓈ-M Futures. A council of AI models works through each decision, using your own API keys. Deterministic rules then decide whether an order is sent.

data.name: RecordCaption
data.value: An example, not a real trade.

data.name: RecordTechnical
data.value: The long is below entry. Support is holding.

data.name: RecordStrategist
data.value: Add to the long at support.

data.name: RecordRiskEngine
data.value: Rejected. Adding to a position at a loss isn't allowed.

data.name: NoticeRiskHeading
data.comment: EXT-UI-03. Pending legal review in #58.

data.name: NoticeRiskBody
data.value: Automated cryptocurrency trading can lose money, including all the capital you give an agent. AI models can make decisions that look reasonable and still lose. Past results don't predict future ones, and Demo results don't predict Live ones.
data.comment: EXT-UI-03. Pending legal review in #58.

data.name: NoticeAdviceHeading
data.comment: EXT-UI-03. Pending legal review in #58.

data.name: NoticeAdviceBody
data.value: Ecnanib is not financial advice, and neither is anything an agent or AI model produces. You decide whether to trade, and you're responsible for the outcome.
data.comment: EXT-UI-03. Keep the phrase "not financial advice". Pending legal review in #58.

data.name: NoticeAffiliationHeading
data.comment: EXT-UI-03 and CON-14. Pending legal review in #58.

data.name: NoticeAffiliationBody
data.value: Ecnanib is not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance. It connects to Binance through API keys you create in your own account.
data.comment: EXT-UI-03 and CON-14. Keep the phrase "not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance". Pending legal review in #58.

data.name: StepsIntro
data.value: A cycle runs each time a candle closes on the agent's timeframe.

data.name: StepReconcileBody
data.value: The agent checks its positions and orders against Binance.

data.name: StepCollectBody
data.value: It gathers market data and computes indicators.

data.name: StepAnalyzeBody
data.value: The Technical Analyst and Sentiment Analyst work in parallel.

data.name: StepProposeBody
data.value: The Strategist turns both analyses into a trade, or holds.

data.name: StepChallengeBody
data.value: The Risk Critic approves, modifies or rejects the proposal.

data.name: StepEnforceBody
data.value: The Risk Engine sizes the order and applies hard limits. AI output can't bypass it.

data.name: StepExecuteBody
data.value: The order goes to Binance, or waits for your approval in Confirm mode.

data.name: RolesIntro
data.value: You choose the provider and model for each role, per agent. One provider can fill every role.

data.name: RoleTechnicalAnalystJob
data.value: Analyzes price action, indicators and higher-timeframe structure

data.name: RoleSentimentAnalystJob
data.value: Assesses current news and social sentiment

data.name: RoleStrategistJob
data.value: Combines the analyses into a trade proposal

data.name: RoleReviewerJob
data.value: Writes a lesson after each trade closes

data.name: PrincipleStopsBody
data.value: Every open position has a stop resting on Binance, so an Ecnanib outage doesn't leave it unprotected.

data.name: PrincipleDemoBody
data.value: New agents start in Demo. Going Live takes an explicit opt-in.

data.name: PrincipleTraceBody
data.value: You can read the inputs, prompts, responses, risk checks and orders behind any cycle.

data.name: PrincipleKeysBody
data.value: You bring your own API keys, encrypted at rest. Binance keys that can withdraw funds are rejected.

data.name: TooManyAttempts
data.value: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
data.comment: Plain text, sent with a 429 from the sign-in and registration forms.

data.name: SignInRefused
data.value: We couldn't sign you in. Check your email and password. After several failed attempts, sign-in pauses for a while, so wait before trying again.
data.comment: One message for a wrong password, an unknown address and a locked account, so it mustn't tell them apart.

data.name: SignInAfterRegistering
data.value: Registration received. Sign in to continue. If you already have an account with this address, use its existing password.
data.comment: The same for a new address and a taken one, so it mustn't tell them apart.

data.name: RegisterCountryBlocked

data.name: TermsOfUseService
data.value: Ecnanib is a free tool for running automated trading agents on your own Binance account. It is offered as is, and it may change or stop at any time.

data.name: TermsOfUseResponsibility
data.value: You are responsible for your agents and for every order they place. You are also responsible for being eligible to use Binance where you live, and Ecnanib does not check this.

data.name: TermsOfUseCredentials
data.value: You bring your own exchange and AI provider keys, and you pay those providers for what you use. Your exchange keys must not have withdrawal permission.

data.name: TermsOfUseChanges
data.value: If these terms change in a way that matters, you will be asked to accept them again before you continue.

data.name: RiskDisclosureLoss
data.value: Trading crypto assets can lose you some or all of your money, and leverage can lose it faster. Only trade what you can afford to lose.

data.name: RiskDisclosureAutomation
data.value: AI models make mistakes, and rule checks limit losses without preventing them. Markets, exchanges and this service can all fail at the worst moment.

data.name: RiskDisclosureNoAdvice
data.value: Nothing in Ecnanib is financial advice, and Ecnanib is not affiliated with or endorsed by Binance.

data.name: RiskDisclosureDemo
data.value: Results in Demo differ from live trading, and past results do not predict future ones.
